mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.2% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1050.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand for dwellings, triggering positive equity market sentiment and 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 1050.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production below 101.0 and retail sales above 440,000 million dollars signals weak manufacturing output and strong consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of periods where INDPRO < 101.0 and RSAFS > 440000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 5.0% during late-cycle expansion indicates labor market tightness that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 35% of periods where UNRATE < 5.0 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 1.5% annualized rate signals sustained economic expansion, increasing corporate profitability expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 45% of quarters where GDPC1 growth > 1.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% per year indicates accelerating price pressures that prompt central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth above 140,000 thousand and unemployment below 5.0% indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 140000.0 and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 101.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as recession fears rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 55% of periods where INDPRO < 101.0 for 2 consecutive months.
